description:
Hushfeed v0.39.0 targets global TikTok 46.2.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Two tracker fixes. Ads no longer appear while paging through a creator's videos from their profile: TikTok's mid-roll ad component was swapping an ad into the pager in place of the video on screen after every list had loaded, and Remove feed ads now refuses that swap. Hide Tako AI now also hides the Ask strip under a video's caption, which a different component draws from the floating button the switch already covered. Both are checked on the four retained builds and named in the diagnostic export.

Validation: 1374 runtime tests passed locally, plus the patches module suite. The bundle carries 81 patches and all three DEX payloads are non-empty. All patches applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

The downloadable .mpp is the patch bundle. Patch on the device with Morphe Manager and keep its existing signing key.

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Replaces TikTok's dark background palette with black or a chosen color. The light theme keeps its colors. It is the one patch that rewrites resources, so patching with it on needs the memory limit raised to 768 MB.

options.description: An opaque hex color. Black turns off OLED pixels on the main dark surfaces.

patches.name: Advanced downloads
patches.description: Adds download quality choices, saves Photo Mode images directly from their source URLs, keeps a video's sound as its own audio file, and saves a profile picture or a story from a long press.

patches.name: Allow Duet and Stitch
patches.description: Ignores the creator's Duet and Stitch setting so the entries appear for videos that closed them. Everything else the app checks still applies: a photo post, a private video or one with music it may not reuse is still refused, and whether the upload is accepted is the server's decision, not the app's.

patches.name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search
patches.description: Removes secure window flags and disables the Circle to Search block. Off by default; restart after changing.

patches.name: Always show publish date
patches.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information.

patches.name: Automatic video advance
patches.description: Keeps TikTok's automatic advance enabled while preserving its pause, dialog and gesture checks, and shows TikTok's own Auto scroll action in the video panel for accounts outside its rollout.

patches.name: Block P2P video relay
patches.description: Strips TikTok's peer-to-peer CDN libraries so your phone is not used as a relay node for other people's video traffic. Saves battery and mobile data.

patches.name: Block author button
patches.description: Adds one-tap controls for blocking the creator, hiding them locally and blocking the current sound. The local-hide and sound controls have separate switches. Long press any visible control to move it, and all of them hide while comments are open.

patches.name: Block contact list access
patches.description: Stops TikTok from reading your phone contacts. Find Friends and People you may know lose access to your contact list.

patches.name: Block installed app scanning
patches.description: Stops TikTok from reading the list of apps installed on your phone. TikTok uses this for device fingerprinting and ad targeting.

patches.name: Camera and microphone indicator
patches.description: Shows a small colored dot when TikTok accesses the camera or microphone. Green for camera, orange for microphone. Stays visible until the access ends.

patches.name: Comment publish diagnostics
patches.description: Says in the diagnostic report whether a comment send reached TikTok's publish code, what it had in hand, and whether it returned early or handed the comment to the request. A comment that never posts leaves no other trace.

patches.name: Comment sort controls
patches.description: Shows TikTok's own comment sort sheet on every post, with its hot, newest, media and creator options, instead of the cut-down row an account outside the rollout is given.

patches.name: Comment tools
patches.description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button that shows the block symbol, makes a web address in a comment tappable, hides comment media and polls, and adds a box above the comments that narrows them by what they say or who said it.

patches.name: Confirm feed interactions
patches.description: Adds optional second-tap protection to the feed Follow button and like heart. A red ring marks the armed button.

patches.name: Copy comments without username
patches.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches.name: Device privacy guard
patches.description: Blocks TikTok from reading your clipboard contents and scanning devices on your local network. Clipboard writes (copying links you asked for) are not affected.

patches.name: Diagnostic tools
patches.description: Adds diagnostic logging, filtered reports and local TikTok crash capture. The switches are under Diagnostics in Hushfeed settings.

patches.name: Disable login requirement
patches.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches.name: Disable telemetry
patches.description: Adds an App behavior toggle that stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, explicit Firebase screen reports and TikTok's Npth or MonitorCrash startup reporting. TikTok's own diagnostics go quiet with them. Off by default.

patches.name: Disable the long press quick share
patches.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches.name: Disable the long press repost
patches.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches.name: Double-tap controls
patches.description: Lets double taps do nothing or open the current video's comments.

patches.name: Downloads
patches.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates. It ignores the flag TikTok sets when a creator turns downloading off, so those videos save too. Network fetches accept public HTTPS addresses and follow at most five checked redirects.

patches.name: Drop the animated image cache
patches.description: Makes TikTok's reviewed Fresco animated-frame cache lookups return no cached frame. This can increase decoding work or change animation playback.

patches.name: Enable voice comments
patches.description: Turns on TikTok's own voice comment recording and publishing entry points for accounts that do not have them.

patches.name: Expand activity list
patches.description: Adds an option to show the full Activity and New followers lists instead of collapsing them behind a View all button.

patches.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches.name: Feature Gate Recorder
patches.description: Records feature gate reads while you use TikTok and compares them with their previous values.

patches.name: Feed filter
patches.description: Hides feed ads, including videos with creator commission disclosures, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labeled videos, verified accounts, series, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from and their view, like, comment, favorite and share counts. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed, and so are the mid-roll ads TikTok splices into a video pager after the list has loaded. The share prompt that appears after a like can also be hidden.

patches.name: Feed tab navigation
patches.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches.name: Fit the video to the screen
patches.description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off.

patches.name: Fix Google login
patches.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches.name: Foldable split comment view
patches.description: Shows comments beside the video on windows wider than a configurable threshold. Off by default.

patches.name: Follow diagnostics
patches.description: Reads what the server said about a follow. A follow TikTok turns down comes back looking like a success, so this reports the refusal and its reason once per session and, with diagnostic logging on, writes the whole exchange to the report.

patches.name: Ghost mode
patches.description: Adds an option to stop TikTok reporting that you viewed a story or a profile or that you are typing. Online status is unchanged.

patches.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any puzzle the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message.

patches.name: Hide already seen videos
patches.description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and drops them from later feed pages. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings.

patches.name: Hide comment popup ads
patches.description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji.

patches.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds. Shares its switch with the Live entrance option of Hide video overlays, and stops the button before it is built rather than hiding it once it is on screen.

patches.name: Hide feed follow button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches.name: Hide feed save button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the save button from video feeds.

patches.name: Hide feed search button
patches.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches.name: Hide floating promotions
patches.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches.name: Hide inbox items
patches.description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually.

patches.name: Hide inbox stories
patches.description: Hides the stories tray at the top of the Inbox and restores it immediately when the switch is turned off. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items.

patches.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches.name: Hide search suggestions
patches.description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone.

patches.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches.description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages, and collapses every other People you may like card: the profile header, the Friends tab and the feed. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items.

patches.name: Hide the launcher shortcuts
patches.description: Empties the menu that opens on pressing and holding TikTok's icon on the home screen. The entries are built while the app runs rather than declared in it, and TikTok only rewrites them when it notices a difference, so this takes away what is already published and answers the handover that would publish more. Turning it off asks TikTok to build them again. Tapping the icon still opens the app, and a shortcut pinned to a home screen is left alone.

patches.name: Hide the risk control CAPTCHA
patches.description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, raised by its BdTuring service, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default.

patches.name: Hide video overlays
patches.description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the Live entrance in the top left corner, caption and music text, selected action buttons or their counts in the right column, survey cards and the status bar.

patches.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches.name: In-app browser privacy guard
patches.description: Stops TikTok from injecting JavaScript tracking interfaces into the in-app browser's WebView. Links redirected to the system browser by Open external links directly are not affected.

patches.name: Keep the Favorites tab
patches.description: Keeps the Favorites tab on your profile when TikTok's server puts the account into an experiment that empties it. Two people saw that after patching: the tab was there and the saved videos were not.

patches.name: Keep the screen's refresh rate
patches.description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone.

patches.name: Limit background traffic
patches.description: Turns off TikTok's buffer-preload gate and skips its push initialization task. Videos may start buffering later, and TikTok push notifications may stop.

patches.name: Location access governor
patches.description: Blocks TikTok from reading your real GPS location. Location requests return null. Goes beyond the SIM and region spoof, which changes the locale and timezone but not the coordinates.

patches.name: Long-press controls
patches.description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, or copy the link to the video or its sound, and can turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control.

patches.name: Not interested button
patches.description: Adds a movable button that tells TikTok you aren't interested in the current video. It hides while comments are open. Off by default.

patches.name: Notification controls
patches.description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected.

patches.name: Open external links directly
patches.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser.

patches.name: Playback quality
patches.description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting.

patches.name: Playback speed
patches.description: Remembers playback speed or applies a default to each new video, with custom menu choices up to 3x.

patches.name: Region spoof
patches.description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with a separate experimental store-region switch.

patches.name: Remember clear display
patches.description: Remembers clear display between videos, or enters it automatically after a chosen delay.

patches.name: Remove LIVE extras
patches.description: Empties TikTok's link-mic and LIVE match or minigame assets, then skips its gift-effect widget setup. Co-hosting, games and animated gifts may stop.

patches.name: Remove content credential and card scanner assets
patches.description: Empties TikTok's bundled C2PA and Microblink card-scanning assets, Pitaya AI engine libraries, the live-cast dynamic feature, and runtime monitoring probes.

patches.name: Remove creation tools
patches.description: Empties TikTok's reviewed editor, camera-effect and face-model assets. Recording, editing, effects and creator tools may stop working.

patches.name: Remove unused language packs
patches.description: Empties unselected TikTok language bundles while always keeping English. Selected language codes are checked before any file changes.

options.description: Comma-separated language codes such as en, es, pt, fr or de. English is always kept.

patches.name: Resource and battery governor
patches.description: Blocks TikTok from polling device sensors for fingerprinting and throttles background buffer preloading. Reduces battery drain from motion tracking and prefetch.

patches.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches.name: SIM spoof
patches.description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.

patches.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared, and can put a host of your choosing in place of tiktok.com.

patches.name: Settings
patches.description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok.

patches.name: Share sheet tools
patches.description: Asks twice before a video is sent to a friend from the share sheet. The check follows the account or conversation instead of the visible name and covers accessibility actions and keyboard input. It can also hide chosen people, share options or the whole Send to row.

patches.name: Show LIVE search
patches.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches.name: Show author region
patches.description: Adds an option to show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed.

patches.name: Show the progress bar
patches.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches.name: Show the progress bar thumbnail
patches.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches.name: Skip content warnings
patches.description: Adds an option to play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first.

patches.name: Skip the splash ad
patches.description: Stops TikTok's splash-ad preload tasks and returns false from its reviewed splash and TopView gates. Other startup behavior is left in place.

patches.name: Skip update checks
patches.description: Skips TikTok's background and boot-finished device-ID update-check tasks. This may suppress some in-app update checks. Play Store updates are unaffected.

patches.name: Stop on-device AI profiling
patches.description: Kills the Pitaya on-device ML inference engine at startup so it cannot build a behavioral profile. The AI asset strip in the core de-bloat patch removes the native libraries; this stops the initialization code that would download replacements.

patches.name: Stop video looping
patches.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches.name: Subtitle tools
patches.description: Saves subtitle files beside downloaded videos and adds caption size, background, and clear-display options.

patches.name: Translate comments
patches.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.

patches.name: Use non-personalized search
patches.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

release_notes:
## What changed

Two reports from the tracker, both about something the bundle was not looking at.

**Ads while paging through a creator's videos (issue 2).** TikTok has a mid-roll ad component that waits for the pager to load, then takes the video on screen and an ad, finds the video in the pager and puts the ad in its place. That happens after every list the feed filter reads, which is why the exports on that issue showed a profile list of 184 organic videos with nothing removed while the reporter was looking at an ad. The ad was never in the list. Remove feed ads now refuses that swap on all four retained builds. The video the ad would have replaced stays where it was, and the diagnostic export carries a `mid-roll ads` row and a `MidAdInsert` line, so the next report can say whether the route ran and what it kept out.

**The "Ask" strip under a video (issue 6).** Hide Tako AI covered the floating Tako button and left the "Ask a question about this video" strip under the caption standing, because a different component draws it. With the switch on, that strip is now hidden before it is filled.

Neither could be provoked on the test phone, so both fixes are proven on the four builds the bundle is checked against and on the phone's own export, and the reporters have the final word.

## Install

Add this repository as a source in Morphe Manager, or download `patches-0.39.0.mpp` and load it as a local bundle. You need Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

## What it was built and checked against

81 patches, all applying on TikTok 46.2.3 (the declared target), 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3. `release-receipt-0.39.0.json` records the commit, the bundle's hash, each fixture it was proved against and what patching did to the manifest. `SHA256SUMS.txt` covers both files.
